jetlag.plan.closeAlready: Shifting your sleep first should bring you close to local time. Keep to local meal and sleep times.
jetlag.plan.settled: After that, keep to local meal and sleep times.
jetlag.plan.none: Your flights change the clock by less than 3 h, so there is no adjust plan for this trip.
jetlag.plan.ready: A simple adjust plan is ready: {summary}
journal.title: Journal
journal.notFound: This trip isn’t on this device any more.
journal.offline: Your journal stays on this phone and works in flight mode. Photos are copied into Satchel and never uploaded.
journal.exportNote: Exporting the trip includes your journal text. Photos stay on this phone.
journal.empty.title: Start your travel diary
journal.empty.body: Write a few lines each day, add up to six photos, and note the mood and the weather. Everything stays on this phone.
journal.addHint: Opens a new journal page for this trip.
journal.addToDayHint: Opens a new journal page for this day.
journal.entry.openHint: Opens this page to edit it.
journal.today.title: Today’s page
journal.today.prompt: How was today? Jot it down before it fades.
journal.slot.title: Journal
journal.slot.noneBody: A few lines and photos for each day of the trip.
journal.edit.title: Edit page
journal.edit.dayPrevHint: Moves this page to the day before.
journal.edit.dayNextHint: Moves this page to the day after.
journal.edit.placeEmpty: Save places from the map to link one here.
journal.edit.photosFull: This page has six photos, the most it can hold. Remove one to add another.
journal.edit.addLibraryHint: Opens your photo library. Picked photos are copied into Satchel.
journal.edit.addCameraHint: Opens the camera. The photo is copied into Satchel and stays on this phone.
journal.edit.refused: Only six photos fit on a page, so {n} were left out.
journal.edit.photoRemoveHint: Takes this photo off the page.
journal.edit.saveHint: Saves this page to the trip journal.
journal.edit.deleteHint: Deletes this page and its photos from this phone.
journal.edit.deleteBody: The note and its photos are removed from this phone. This can’t be undone.
journal.edit.err.empty: Write a note, add a photo, or pick a mood, the weather or a place.
journal.edit.err.day: Pick a day for this page.
journal.edit.err.photos: A page holds up to six photos.
journal.edit.saveFailed.title: Couldn’t save the page
journal.edit.saveFailed.body: This phone couldn’t store it. Your page is still here: try again in a moment.
journal.edit.camera.denied: Camera access is off for Satchel. Turn it on in Settings, or choose photos from your library instead.
journal.edit.camera.unavailable: This phone has no camera Satchel can use. Choose photos from your library instead.
journal.edit.photos.denied: Satchel can’t open your photos. Allow Photos access in Settings, or take a photo with the camera instead.
journal.edit.photos.unreadable: That photo couldn’t be read. Try another one.
journal.edit.photos.storage: There isn’t enough space on this phone to copy that photo.
journal.edit.openSettingsHint: Opens Satchel in the Settings app.
jetlag.call.noneAhead: No overlap in the next {days} days: there is no time when both clocks are between {from} and {to}.
triproute.seeOnMapHint: Opens the map with this trip’s bookings as numbered stops, day by day.
triproute.chipHint: Shows only that day’s stops on the map.
triproute.heading: Trip on the map
triproute.straightNote: Distances are straight lines between stops; walking routes are longer.
triproute.dayNone: No bookings with a map position on this day.
triproute.dayRowHint: Shows that day on the map.
triproute.directionsHint: Opens Apple Maps with walking directions between these two stops.
triproute.directionsFailed: Couldn’t open Apple Maps on this phone.
triproute.savedOne: Plus 1 saved place, shown with a bookmark colour.
triproute.savedMany: Plus {n} saved places, shown with a bookmark colour.
triproute.transportStopsHint: Shows or hides where journeys leave from and arrive, as stops on the route.
triproute.emptyBody: Stops show here when a booking’s place has a map position. Edit a booking and choose Set on map or Pick a saved place under its place. To keep a spot with this trip, tap it on the map above and choose Save place.
weather.title: Weather & daylight
weather.subtitle: {place} · local time
weather.stale: Forecast from {time}. It is over 2 days old, so it may be out of date.
weather.none: No forecast saved for this place yet. It loads when you are online; sunrise and sunset work offline.
weather.notYet: No forecast for this day yet
weather.polarDay: The sun stays up all day
weather.polarNight: The sun stays down all day
weather.line.polarDay: Midnight sun: the sun stays up today
weather.line.polarNight: Polar night: the sun stays down today
weather.unitSettingBody: Used for the forecast on the trip screen.
share.openHint: Choose what to share, then send it as text from the share sheet.
share.title: Share plan
share.body: Sends a readable text copy of your plan. Documents, tickets, attachments, notes and your emergency card are never included.
share.codesHint: Adds booking references to the text. Off unless you turn it on.
share.sendHint: Opens the share sheet with this text.
share.failed: The share sheet didn’t open. Try again.
share.subject: {name}: plan
share.text.nothing: Nothing booked for these days yet.
brief.title: Your day
brief.tonightHint: Opens the address card to show your driver.
